clauses.evidence: keywords[0] ENCHANT(TYPE_EQ Creature). Stimulus 'from your hand, the card enters during the opponent's turn': 'ask enchant: [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]' offers creatures only (no relic/charm).

clauses.clause: You can't choose an untapped creature as this spell's target as you cast it.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: 'target slot (cast): 1..1 of [opp_tapped]', the only tapped creature; every untapped creature (yours and the opponent's) is excluded. In the non-cast entry stimulus untapped creatures are offered, which is correct (not cast, so no target, CR 303.4f). Tree matches the canonical template B4-enthralling-target-choice; the engine reads it only off the battlefield at the target choice (legality.py:505), and no consumer treats the battlefield copy as a global targeting veto.

The probe's snapshot reads world.controller_of (zone owner, probe.py:302), not the executor's control overlay, so no trace line can show a control change. Packs: enthralling_hold_you_control_enchanted (cast on tapped opp 3/3: attached to it, effective controller seat 0, the other opp creature stays seat 1) PASS; enthralling_hold_control_ends_when_aura_leaves (Aura moved to the graveyard: control back to seat 1) PASS.
clauses.issue: Represented as the canonical durationless GAIN_CONTROL on the Aura's carrier, anchored to the Aura (verbs.py:2197). Weaker-only gap: an Enthralling Hold put onto the battlefield without being cast would not take control. Not stronger.
